limitations: Engineering 1e-5 is too loose for cavity Marchi accuracy; tolerance sweep is retained.
SIMPLEC and SIMPLE reach different discrete roots on archived DFG. Cross-restarts retain the starting branch. This is not a qualified speedup.
Annulus SIMPLEC with pressure relaxation 1 fails.
Earlier efficiency-curved live-binary batch is excluded; only fixed executable snapshot results are used.
Small-case timings are not product-density performance evidence.
